name: qr-gen
description: Small QR code generator (transparent PNG) with login, dark mode and an activity log, for Cloudflare Workers.

QR_GEN_USER.description: Username for signing in to qr-gen. Defaults to "admin" if left empty.

QR_GEN_PASSWORD.description: Password for signing in to qr-gen. Choose something long: the app is public on the internet. Sign-in stays disabled until this is set.
